newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade $63, steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade $63, steady - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Most trade has been in the south plains. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from some buyers.
Sales reported on 9,000 slaughter steers and 9,600 heifers; 19,700 head confirmed for the week to date.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 63.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 63.00.
Confirmed - 18,600 Week Ago - None Year Ago - 400
Wk to date - 19,700 Week Ago - 44,400 Year Ago - 400
